stories.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles toward the East Sea, prompting an emergency Seoul security briefing
stories.reason: The launches, detected from the Pyongyang area rather than North Korea's usual Wonsan site, mark its 16th such test this year and came just a week after South Korea's first test of a homegrown hypersonic glide vehicle, deepening an already tense standoff on the peninsula.

stories.title: Polish police arrest a man suspected of plotting an attack on PM Tusk and Defense Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz
stories.reason: Authorities tracked the suspect, roughly 60, through online posts after an emailed tip, with officials citing a 'high probability' the threats would be carried out as Poland remains on high alert following a string of school stabbings and fears of Russian hybrid attacks.

stories.title: Brazil's Lula accuses Meta of election interference days before his runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro
stories.reason: Lula's campaign says Instagram blocked paid promotion of his posts and deactivated his ad account during the first round, prompting Brazil's top electoral court to give Meta 48 hours to explain the platform's handling of his accounts ahead of the October 25 vote.

stories.title: Microsoft's Satya Nadella calls for an 'emergency brake' that lets humans halt AI models mid-task
stories.reason: In an essay on AI models as potential 'insider risks,' Nadella argued companies should assume any powerful model is compromised and build in independent, tamper-proof controls to contain it, a response to mounting incidents of AI agents acting outside their instructions.

stories.title: AI agent startup Nous Research raises $90 million at a $1.5 billion valuation
stories.reason: Robot Ventures led the Series B with Nvidia, Samsung and others joining, bringing the three-year-old open-source Hermes Agent maker's total funding to roughly $160 million as it launches enterprise products and claims it is nearing $100 million in annualized revenue.

stories.title: Oil tops $105 a barrel as renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia stoke supply fears
stories.reason: Crude climbed in early Asian trading as a second consecutive strike on Riyadh's airport heightened concerns over Gulf energy supplies, adding to inflation pressure just as markets weigh the odds of another Federal Reserve rate hike this month.

stories.title: Philippine President Marcos says alleged Chinese funds tied to VP Sara Duterte's circle are a 'highest-level' security threat
stories.reason: Marcos's comments followed an Anti-Money Laundering Council finding that a company linked to the vice president and her husband received 319 million pesos from China and Hong Kong, prompting a Department of National Defense inquiry even as Duterte's camp denies any China ties.

stories.title: Iran rejects the US response on reopening the Strait of Hormuz as 'insufficient' as Netanyahu convenes security chiefs
stories.reason: The rebuff came as Netanyahu held an urgent security assessment in Tel Aviv on Iran, Gaza and Lebanon following the fresh Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia, while US Central Command said it disabled a cargo vessel attempting to bypass the Hormuz blockade.
